**दस्तावेज़ अपलोड:**
1. चैट बॉक्स में दस्तावेज़ खींचें और छोड़ें या अपलोड करें

- 「文件清單」- वर्तमान आधिकारिक संस्करण के दस्तावेज़ (Word/Excel निर्यात बटन सहित)

adjust_guide.heading: How to Adjust / Adjustment Guidance
adjust_guide.step1: Review Regulation Profile settings — Verify that each country's Regulation Profile content is complete and up to date. If regulations have been updated, use Eira's 'Regulatory List Update' feature to refresh the data.
adjust_guide.step2: Verify MDSAP mode — If your organization holds or plans MDSAP certification, ensure the system has MDSAP mode enabled (7-country cross-examination). If targeting only Taiwan and EU markets, 2-country mode is sufficient.
adjust_guide.step3: Use Eira's Feedback feature — In the daily audit report, provide feedback (agree/disagree/partially agree) on items of concern. The system will record your input and incorporate it into subsequent analysis improvements.
adjust_guide.step4: Check cross-examination depth — If cross-examination rounds are insufficient or ended prematurely, quality scores may be low. Review the Verifier prompt settings to ensure adequate examination depth.
adjust_guide.step5: Regularly review the 10-Day Meta Review — Use the 10-day meta review report to track trend changes and observe whether scores across dimensions are steadily improving. If persistently low, consider adjusting the LLM model or regulatory data.
